At \(x_C\), set \(q=(e^\eta/C-1)/(e^\eta-1)\), \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(+\mid x_C)=q\), distribute \(1-q\) positively over \(-,0\), and set \(\phi(x_C,+)=e_0\), \(\phi(x_C,-)=\phi(x_C,0)=0\), and \(\theta_0=1\). Put \(A=q(C-D)/(D-1)\), add \(x_A\) when \(C>D\) with every action feature equal to \(e_0\), give \(x_C\) raw mass \(\tau=[4(1+A)]^{-1}\) and \(x_A\) raw mass \(\tau A\), and give the hard contexts total raw mass one. Fix \(d\ge4\), \(\eta>0\), and a public experiment \(\mathfrak E\). \[

\]

\[

Fix \(c_0=64\). For every positive integer \(n\) and \(g,f\in\mathcal F\), let \(\pi_g\) be the Gibbs policy generated by \(g\), and define
\[
H_{g,f}(x)=\sum_{a\in\mathcal A}\pi_g(a\mid x)\{g(x,a)-f(x,a)\}^2,
\qquad
\widehat U_n(g)=\sup_{f\in\mathcal Q_n}\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^nH_{g,f}(X_i).
\]
Let \(\widetilde g_n\) be the sequentially lexicographically selected member of \(\operatorname*{arg\,min}_{g\in\mathcal Q_n}\widehat U_n(g)\), and let \(\widehat\pi_{\mathrm{stab}}=\pi_{\widetilde g_n}\). This is a measurable member of \(\mathcal L_n(\mathfrak E)\), uses only \((\mathcal D_n,\mathfrak E)\), and uses neither \(\rho\), \(C\), nor \(D\) as input. Put
\[
a_n=d\log(en)+\log(2n^2),
\]
\[
b_n=\frac{8}{3n}\left[\log(4n^2)+2d\log\{1+4n(\eta+2)\}\right]+\frac3n,
\qquad
V_n=D\left(3000\frac{a_n}{n}+3b_n\right).
\]
For every nonempty exact shell and every positive integer \(n\),
\[
\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathfrak E}(d,C,D,\eta)}
\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n}}\left[J_{\eta,P}(\pi_P^\star)-J_{\eta,P}(\widehat\pi_{\mathrm{stab}})\right]
\le
\min\left\{\eta V_n,\sqrt{2V_n}\right\}
+\delta_n\min\{2,\eta/2\}.
\]
Moreover, for every \(\epsilon\in(0,1)\), the following explicit inversion holds. If \(\eta\le2\epsilon\), then
\[
N^\star_{\mathfrak E}(\epsilon;d,C,D,\eta)=1.
\]
If \(\eta>2\epsilon\), define
\[
q_\epsilon=dD\min\{\eta/\epsilon,\epsilon^{-2}\},
\qquad
\ell_\epsilon=1+\log(eq_\epsilon)+\log\{1+(1+\eta)q_\epsilon\},
\]
\[
n_0=\left\lceil10^8q_\epsilon\ell_\epsilon\right\rceil.
\]
Then
\[
\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{\mathfrak E}(d,C,D,\eta)}
\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes n_0}}\left[J_{\eta,P}(\pi_P^\star)-J_{\eta,P}(\widehat\pi_{\mathrm{stab}})\right]
\le\epsilon,
\qquad
N^\star_{\mathfrak E}(\epsilon;d,C,D,\eta)\le n_0.
\]

\[
N^\star_{\mathfrak E}(\epsilon;d,C,D,\eta)
\le\widetilde O\left(dD\min\{\eta/\epsilon,\epsilon^{-2}\}\right).
\]

defs.def:prediction-polytope-learner:
Let \(S=\mathcal X\times\mathcal A\) and \(\mathcal F=\{f\in[0,1]^S:\exists\theta\in\mathbb R^d,\ f(x,a)=\phi(x,a)^\top\theta\}\). Fix once and for all a lexicographic order of \(S\). Set \(L_n(f)=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^n(Y_i-f(X_i,A_i))^2\), and let \(\widehat f\) be the sequentially lexicographically selected minimizer of \(L_n\) over the compact polytope \(\mathcal F\). Define \(\|h\|_n^2=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^nh(X_i,A_i)^2\) and \(\mathcal Q_n=\{f\in\mathcal F:\|f-\widehat f\|_n^2\le c_0[d\log(en)+\log(2n^2)]/n\}\). The set \(\mathcal Q_n\) is nonempty and compact because it contains \(\widehat f\). For every \((x,a)\in S\), define the unique minimum value \(\underline r_n(x,a)=\min_{f\in\mathcal Q_n}f(x,a)\); if an attaining witness is needed, select one sequentially lexicographically using the fixed order of \(S\). Define the deployed policy at every context, observed or unobserved, by
\[
\widehat\pi(a\mid x)=\frac{\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(a\mid x)e^{\eta\underline r_n(x,a)}}{\sum_{b\in\mathcal A}\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(b\mid x)e^{\eta\underline r_n(x,b)}}.
\]

There are constants \(\epsilon_1(C,D,\eta)\in(0,\epsilon_0(C,D,\eta)]\) and \(c(C,D,\eta)>0\) such that, for every \(0<\epsilon\le\epsilon_1(C,D,\eta)\), \(N^\star(\epsilon;d,C,D,\eta)\ge c(C,D,\eta)dD\eta/\epsilon\). Thus the displayed paired-Bernoulli family proves the local fast branch; it does not prove the \(\epsilon^{-2}\) branch.

defs.def:common-experiment: Fix the finite supports \(\mathcal X,\mathcal A\), the known feature map \(\phi\), the known reference and logging policy \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}\), and \(\eta\) as \(\mathfrak E=(\mathcal X,\mathcal A,\phi,\pi_{\mathrm{ref}},\eta)\). The context distribution \(\rho\) is not a component of \(\mathfrak E\); it remains law-specific. For every compatible one-observation law \(P\), \(\mathcal D_n\sim P^{\otimes n}\). A learner is an element of \(\mathcal L_n(\mathfrak E)\), so it receives \(\mathcal D_n\) and \(\mathfrak E\). Write \(\mathcal M_{\mathfrak E}(d,C,D,\eta)\), \(\mathfrak R_{n,\mathfrak E}\), and \(N^\star_{\mathfrak E}\) whenever public experiments are compared. The unindexed notation \(\mathcal M(d,C,D,\eta)\), \(\mathfrak R_n\), and \(N^\star\) is an abbreviation only after one \(\mathfrak E\) has been fixed and no cross-experiment comparison is being made.
defs.def:explicit-hard-family:
For \((C,D)\in\mathfrak F_{\mathrm{hard}}^\circ(d,\eta)\), put \(k=\lfloor(d-1)/2\rfloor\), take an orthonormal basis \(e_0,(u_j,w_j)_{j=1}^k\), and add \(z\) when \(d\) is even. Use actions \(\{+,-,0\}\). At \(x_C\), set \(q=(e^\eta/C-1)/(e^\eta-1)\), \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(+\mid x_C)=q\), distribute \(1-q\) positively over \(-,0\), and set \(\phi(x_C,+)=e_0\), \(\phi(x_C,-)=\phi(x_C,0)=0\), and \(\theta_0=1\). Put \(A=q(C-D)/(D-1)\), add \(x_A\) when \(C>D\) with every action feature equal to \(e_0\), give \(x_C\) raw mass \(\tau=[4(1+A)]^{-1}\) and \(x_A\) raw mass \(\tau A\), and give the hard contexts total raw mass one. When \(z\) is present, add \(x_z\) with raw mass \(1/4\), every action feature \(z\), and coefficient zero. Normalize these raw masses to define \(\rho\). At each \(x_j\), of raw mass \(1/k\), put \(p=(4D)^{-1}\), \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(+\mid x_j)=\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(-\mid x_j)=p\), \(\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(0\mid x_j)=1-2p\), \(\phi(x_j,+)=(u_j+w_j)/\sqrt2\), \(\phi(x_j,-)=(u_j-w_j)/\sqrt2\), and \(\phi(x_j,0)=0\). For \(v\in\{-1,1\}^k\), let \(T_\gamma=D(1-2p)/[e^{\eta\gamma}-2pD\cosh(\eta\gamma)]\), \(\beta=\eta^{-1}\log T_\gamma\), and \(\theta_{u_j}=\sqrt2\beta\), \(\theta_{w_j}=\sqrt2\gamma v_j\), so \(r_v(x_j,\pm)=\beta\pm\gamma v_j\). Define
\[
g_0(D,\eta)=\sup\left\{g>0:\text{ for every }s\in[0,g],\ e^{\eta s}-2pD\cosh(\eta s)>0\text{ and }s\le\eta^{-1}\log T_s\le1-s\right\},
\]
and set \(\gamma(\epsilon,d,C,D,\eta)=\eta^{-1}\operatorname{arcosh}(e^{64\eta\epsilon})\). The family \(\mathcal H_{d,C,D,\eta,\epsilon}\) comprises these \(2^k\) Bernoulli laws whenever \(\gamma\le\min\{g_0(D,\eta),1/4,\beta,1-\beta\}\).
defs.def:exact-shell: \(\mathcal M_{\mathfrak E}(d,C,D,\eta)=\{P:\ P\text{ is compatible with the fixed public experiment }\mathfrak E,\ \rho\text{ is the context distribution supplied by }P,\text{ and ass:finite-contexts, ass:finite-actions, ass:bounded-features, ass:linear-realizability, ass:reference-logging, ass:nonsingular-logging-geometry, ass:pointwise-exact-shell, and ass:feature-exact-shell hold for }P\}\). When \(\mathfrak E\) is fixed and no experiments are compared, write \(\mathcal M(d,C,D,\eta)=\mathcal M_{\mathfrak E}(d,C,D,\eta)\).
defs.def:sample-complexity:
For \(\mathcal M_{\mathfrak E}(d,C,D,\eta)\ne\varnothing\), define
\[
N^\star_{\mathfrak E}(\epsilon;d,C,D,\eta)=\inf\left\{n\in\mathbb N:\mathfrak R_{n,\mathfrak E}\bigl(\mathcal M_{\mathfrak E}(d,C,D,\eta)\bigr)\le\epsilon\right\},
\]
with the convention \(\inf\varnothing=\infty\). When \(\mathfrak E\) is fixed and no experiments are compared, write \(N^\star=N^\star_{\mathfrak E}\).

snapshot.stmt: Under the canonical tabular specialization \(d=|S|\) and \(\phi(x,a)=e_{(x,a)}\), \(\Lambda_{\mathrm{ref}}^{-1/2}\Lambda_P^\star\Lambda_{\mathrm{ref}}^{-1/2}\) is diagonal with entries \(\pi_P^\star(a\mid x)/\pi_{\mathrm{ref}}(a\mid x)\). Hence \(D_P=C_P\), and the exact shell \(\mathcal M(d,C,C,\eta)\) reduces to the canonical tabular reverse-KL shell.
